title: Harem 2 AIO Armored - Character Bios
tagline: Hand-written SkyrimNet bios for 18 NPCs from Harem 2 AIO Armored.
description:
Official SkyrimNet character bios for NPCs added by Harem 2 AIO Armored (Harem 2 AIO Armored.esp).

Install this if Harem 2 AIO Armored.esp is in your load order. NPCs without a static bio still get one generated automatically from their game data; this pack replaces that with the community-curated version.

Bios are the work of the SkyrimNet community.
